Question 1: Write short answers to the following questions:

1. What are the four important big exports of Pakistan?

A. (i) cotton thread; (ii) rice; (iii) bedwear; (iv) cotton.

2. State the benefits that accrue to Pakistan from foreign trade.

A. (i) increase in foreign exchange; (ii) improvement in economic stability; (iii) increase in employment; (iv) acquaintance with new technology.

3. What is meant by the remittances of workers?

A. When the people of Pakistan, going outside the country and earning money, send it into the country, then it is called the remittances of workers.

4. What is meant by diversification in the export heads of Pakistan?

A. The exports of Pakistan should not be of one nature, but rather should consist of different kinds; dependence cannot be made on one kind of nature.

5. Pakistan has three kinds of imports. State their names.

A. (i) capital goods; (ii) industrial raw material; (iii) consumer goods.

6. State the important imports of Pakistan.

A. (i) machinery (non-electric); (ii) petrol and products; (iii) transport equipment; (iv) chemicals; (v) food items.

7. State four reasons for disorder in the balance of payments of Pakistan.

A. (i) increase in imports; (ii) increase in the prices of imports; (iii) exports are less; (iv) decrease in workers’ remittances.

8. Which countries are included in the Economic Cooperation Organisation?

A. (i) Pakistan; (ii) Turkey; (iii) Iran.

9. Write four benefits of international trade.

A. (i) acquisition of necessary goods; (ii) surplus to need; (iii) agricultural and industrial development; (iv) means of government income.
